gpu.h

The app's GPU: the device and queue the app shares with the library and its filters (hdrg_context_set_device), the frames a session takes and gives on that GPU (hdrg_device_frame_t), and the shaders and the state to run the apply pass on the app's own GPU (hdrg_shader, hdrg_apply_state_t). Includes hdrgrading.h; video.h and plugin.h include it.

GPU describes where the library runs on the GPU and how frames stay there.

Source: include/hdrgrading/gpu.h

hdrg_vulkan_device_t structline 42

HDRG_DEVICE_VULKAN's device (Vulkan 1.1 or later): the handles the app made it with, kept alive by the app as the device is. The queue (VkQueue, of queue_family, compute) takes the library's submissions from its own threads: lock_queue (NULL: none, the app submits nothing to the queue meanwhile) is called around each, lock true then false. extensions: the device's enabled ones, VK_KHR_push_descriptor among them; VK_KHR_external_memory_fd and VK_EXT_external_memory_dma_buf for dma-buf frames (HDRG_FRAME_DMABUF). The handles' types are Vulkan's

hdrg_device_frame_t structline 97

A frame on the app's GPU (hdrg_session_config_t.device), its Y'CbCr planes (Y, Cb, Cr; Y, CbCr interleaved) or its R'G'B' (plane 0): HDRG_FRAME_BUFFERS: plane i is rows of pitches[i] bytes from offsets[i] in handles[i] (planes may share a buffer; offsets and pitches whole words: multiples of 4), the buffers of the context's device of the kind (hdrg_context_set_device): HDRG_DEVICE_METAL an id<MTLBuffer>, HDRG_DEVICE_VULKAN a VkBuffer of storage usage of sizes[i] bytes (Vulkan cannot tell them), HDRG_DEVICE_WEBGPU a WGPUBuffer of Storage usage. HDRG_FRAME_DMABUF: as HDRG_FRAME_BUFFERS, handles[i] a dma-buf's fd cast to a pointer ((void *)(intptr_t)fd; planes may share one), its layout linear (DRM_FORMAT_MOD_LINEAR), sizes[i] its bytes (0: the dma-buf's own), imported while the library reads or writes it (the fd stays the app's); the context's device HDRG_DEVICE_VULKAN (its own or the app's, with VK_EXT_external_memory_dma_buf). HDRG_FRAME_CVPIXELBUFFER: handles[0] a CVPixelBufferRef backed by an IOSurface (a decoder's, an encoder's pool), its planes and pitches its own, its pixel format the side's (420v / 420f / x420 / xf20 / y420 and their 4:2:2 and 4:4:4 kinds; any device on Apple: HDRG_DEVICE_METAL or HDRG_DEVICE_WEBGPU, the context's own too). Not locked by the library. HDRG_FRAME_AHARDWAREBUFFER: handles[0] an AHardwareBuffer * (a decoder's

image, an encoder's input; Android 8 / API 26 and later), its planes and pitches its own (offsets, pitches and sizes not read), its format one of Vulkan's own (AHARDWAREBUFFER_FORMAT_Y8Cb8Cr8_420 for an NV12 side: 4:2:0, 8 bits, interleaved; AHARDWAREBUFFER_FORMAT_YCbCr_P010 for a P010 side: 10 bits, msb; a vendor's external format alone: HDRG_ERR_UNSUPPORTED), its size the frame's (even sides: the formats' 4:2:0; odd ones HDRG_ERR_UNSUPPORTED); the context's device HDRG_DEVICE_VULKAN (its own, or the app's with VK_ANDROID_external_memory_android_hardware_buffer, VK_EXT_queue_family_foreign and the samplerYcbcrConversion feature). Imported while the library reads or writes it, taken from and given back to its producer outside Vulkan (VK_QUEUE_FAMILY_FOREIGN_EXT, layout GENERAL): the app waits for the producer's fence before the send, and the receive returns once the output is written. Not locked by the library

hdrg_apply_state_t structline 148

A frame's work for the app's own GPU (hdrg_session_receive_state): the state to run the shaders of hdrg_shader with over the app's copy of the frame sent, the bindings of group 0 (SPIR-V: set 0; HLSL: Tint's space 0 registers, the uniform a cbuffer, the storage byte address buffers) as below, every workgroup 64 x 1. Bytes and pitches in bytes. Y'CbCr input first: HDRG_SHADER_CONVERT with 0 uniform: convert_params, convert_params_size bytes 1 read-only storage: the frame sent, its planes packed into yuv_size bytes: Y' rows of yuv_y_pitch from 0, Cb rows of yuv_c_pitch from yuv_cb_at, Cr from yuv_cr_at (interleaved input: Cb, Cr alternating in the rows from yuv_cb_at = yuv_cr_at), the samples as the session's 2, 3, 4 storage: base_size, knots_size, values_size bytes (the GPU's) 5 storage: the 16-bit R'G'B' rows, source_pitch each: the apply's 1 and entry points "sites", "slopes", "pixels" over convert_groups (a group of 0 x 0: none). Then HDRG_SHADER_APPLY with 0 uniform: params, params_size bytes 1 read-only storage: the frame sent (R'G'B' input: its rows packed to source_pitch bytes, the session's format: its bit depth and alpha) or the conversion's rows 2 read-only storage: luts (the same bytes while luts_serial stays) 3 read-only storage: frame 4 storage: the PQ R'G'B' output, dst_size bytes, rows of dst_pitch 5 storage: 4 bytes (not written) 6 storage: the 4:2:0 output, planes_size bytes (4 when none): Y' rows of y_pitch from 0, Cb rows of c_pitch from cb_at, Cr from cr_at (the output interleaved: Cb, Cr alternating in the rows from cb_at = cr_at) and entry point "apply" over groups and, for 4:2:0 output, "yuv" over yuv_groups

hdrg_context_set_device functionline 175

HDRG_API hdrg_status_t hdrg_context_set_device(hdrg_context_t *ctx, uint32_t kind, void *device,
                                               void *queue);

The app's device and queue of a GPU API (HDRG_DEVICE_*) for the filters of the following conversions and sessions (device NULL: none): the plugins' (filter_device), and of a kind the build has (Metal, Vulkan, WebGPU) the library's own GPU filters and its core's GPU passes, in place of a device of the library's own. The app keeps them alive and usable from the library's and the filters' threads while the context is.
